reply_text:
I can't set that up. I have no way to schedule a recurring job that posts into your DM. Scheduled jobs from this environment save their output locally and don't deliver to a chat, so a 09:00 digest would never reach you.

I can still do it on request: when you ask, I'll read #coastal-team (you're a member) and DM you a digest of what's new since the last one. If you want it every morning, a scheduler that can post to Slack would need to be set up by whoever runs this workspace.
